title: mymind use cases
description: Tangerine spaced capitals and a one-line serif headline over a row of audience tabs (the active one tangerine with a small dot under it; on phones a single name between two arrows), then a wide pastel card: small capitals, a two-line serif headline whose second line is italic, and a picture band filling the lower half. The card's text rises softly into place as it scrolls into view.
notes: needs JavaScript to switch tabs; without it the first audience shows
